links.outcome: Reading grade level of ChatGPT-4 responses versus OrthoInfo for meniscus injury questions
links.effect: ChatGPT average reading grade level 13.8 vs 9.8 for OrthoInfo (p<0.01); Flesch Reading Ease 32.0 vs 59.9 (p<0.01).
links.quote: ChatGPT responses required a significantly higher education level to comprehend, with an average reading grade level of 13.8 compared to 9.8 for OrthoInfo (p ​< ​0.01).

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated patient information relative to appropriate user reading level
links.effect: ChatGPT responses averaged grade 13.8 versus 9.8 for OrthoInfo; Flesch Reading Ease 32.0 vs 59.9, indicating lower readability.
links.quote: While AI-generated responses were accurate, their readability made them less accessible than OrthoInfo, which is designed for a broad audience.

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of ChatGPT-4 versus standard patient education material (OrthoInfo) regarding meniscus injuries for readability and accuracy, but it does not test a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
